    The exact Figure-16 quotient retraction #

    This file specializes the occurrence-sensitive Figure-16 coefficient compiler to the exact two-relation selected-corner quotient.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.CriticalFigure16Quotient.branchTarget_ne_of_ne_of_firstArrow_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSPairDichotomy S.ProjectiveCategory] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] {p q : SingularPairNormalization.SingularPair} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hfirst : (↑p).firstArrow = (↑q).firstArrow) :
    (↑p).secondArrow.target.obj.as ≠ (↑q).secondArrow.target.obj.as

    Distinct singular pairs with the same first arrow have distinct branch targets. Parallel irreducible ray arrows with the same endpoints are unique.
